admission.justification: Shared compact styling alone can truncate away the selected choice; complete hovers alone can leave a tall inconsistent or clipped row. Together the two obligations preserve readable choice information while controls share the existing tab look.

guarantee: The role launcher shares the view tabs’ compact visual authority without losing choice information: ordinary controls fit the ruled wide composition, excess controls wrap whole, and every selector retains its complete selected label and default provenance in hover.
title: Compact launcher controls preserve choice information
